//: Stylelint rules for the desktop GUI's stylesheets.
These rules are listed out rather than pulled in with 'extends':
'extends' resolves a shared-config package relative to this file,
but bin/stylelint runs the tool straight out of an npx cache with no
node_modules beside the repository, so the lookup fails. Naming the
rules here keeps the wrapper a single pinned download and makes the
whole policy readable in one place.
The emphasis is on mistakes a browser hides -- an unknown property,
a duplicated selector, a calc() that silently evaluates to nothing.
Purely cosmetic rules are left out; this project has no CSS
formatter and gratuitous reflows would bury real findings.
color-hex-length is set to 'long' because the branding palette in
app.css is a table of six-digit tokens and shortening the three
that happen to compress would leave that table looking ragged.

selector-class-pattern.message: Class selectors are lowercase and hyphen-separated

selector-id-pattern.message: Id selectors are lowercase and hyphen-separated
